toolbar.rulerHint: Height ruler on the selected figure
toolbar.frameMaskHint: Dims whatever falls outside the chosen output, and pulls the camera back so the whole frame fits on screen

figures.title: Figures
figures.empty: No figures in the scene yet.
figures.clipboardCopyHint: Stores the selected figure's pose (joints and settling) so you can paste it onto another figure, even after switching scenes.
figures.clipboardEmpty: Nothing copied yet. Poses kept here last for this session only — closing the tab clears them.
figures.clipboardPasteHint: Applies this pose to the selected figure. Its spot on the floor, its height and its locked joints stay put.
figures.clipboardNoSelection: Select a figure to paste one of these poses.

properties.title: Properties
properties.empty: Select a figure or a joint to see its properties.
properties.activeAxisHint: Use the arrow keys to adjust the highlighted axis.
properties.ikUnreachable: Target out of reach — closest approximation applied.
properties.ikSwivelHint: Swings the elbow around the shoulder→hand axis without taking the hand off the target. It stops where the joint limits stop — the full turn does not exist.
properties.posePresetLyingHint: Lying on the back with the hands behind the head
properties.posePresetFetalHint: Sitting on the ground, hugging the knees
properties.posePresetFightingHint: Fighting guard, left foot forward and fists at face height
properties.posePresetSupermanHint: Flying face down with the arms stretched forward
properties.posePresetModelHint: Magazine model pose: weight on one leg and a hand on the hip
properties.posePresetPunchGivingHint: Right cross at the moment of impact — pairs with "Punch (taking)"
properties.posePresetPunchTakingHint: Head snapped back by the punch — pairs with "Punch (throwing)"
properties.posePresetKickGivingHint: Front kick with the right leg — pairs with "Kick (taking)"
properties.posePresetKickTakingHint: Body folded by the kick to the gut — pairs with "Kick (throwing)"
properties.posePresetChokeGivingHint: From behind, arms wrapped around the neck — pairs with "Headlock (taking)"
properties.posePresetChokeTakingHint: Caught in the headlock, hands on own neck — pairs with "Headlock (applying)"
properties.posePairAuto: Pair pose: applying also puts the other figure in the matching pose and places it accordingly.
properties.posePairManual: Pair pose: the other figure will be left alone — set the encounter up by hand, at the distance shown above.
properties.posePresetAPoseHint: Arms at 45°, the standard reference pose of 3D pipelines
properties.posePresetPointForwardHint: Arm level, index finger extended at shoulder height
properties.posePresetPointUpHint: Arm above the shoulder, back arched and gaze following
properties.posePresetPointDownHint: Low arm with the palm down, torso leaning and head looking at the spot
properties.posePresetPointFarHint: The whole body in the gesture: torso turned and the other arm counterbalancing
properties.posePresetPointAtOtherHint: Hand at the other figure's face height, palm down — pairs at ~0.70 m
properties.posePresetPresentingHint: Arm extended with the palm up, the "this way" gesture
properties.posePresetPointSelfHint: Flat hand on own chest ("who, me?")
properties.posePresetThumbBackHint: Pointing over the shoulder without turning: the thumb marks what is behind
properties.posePresetSquatHint: Deep squat with the feet under the body and the heels lifted
properties.posePresetKneelingOneKneeHint: Right knee down and left foot forward
properties.posePresetKneelingBothHint: On both knees, torso upright and insteps on the ground
properties.posePresetCrossLeggedHint: Sitting on the floor; the hip's abduction limit keeps the cross looser than real
properties.posePresetAllFoursHint: On hands and knees, torso horizontal
properties.posePresetPlankHint: Body straight and inclined, hands under the shoulders and elbows bent
properties.posePresetProneProppedHint: Chest lifted on the forearms, spine extended (sphinx)
properties.posePresetSideLyingHint: On the right side, lower arm stretched above the head
properties.posePresetTouchToesHint: The deepest fold the joints allow — the hands reach shin height, not the feet
properties.posePresetArmsCrossedHint: Forearms crossed over the chest; the shoulder only adducts 20°, so the hands stop at the midline
properties.posePresetHandsOnHipsHint: Wrists on the hip crest, elbows winged out to the sides
properties.posePresetWavingHint: Right hand raised beside the head, palm forward
properties.posePresetCelebratingHint: Both arms up in a V, torso arched and head up
properties.posePresetHandOnChinHint: Thinking: right forearm vertical, left hand propping up the elbow
properties.posePresetHeadDownHint: Dejected, with the shoulders slumped forward
properties.posePresetStartledHint: Recoiling backwards, open hands up in front of the face
properties.posePresetKpopFingerHeartHint: Finger heart (pinch hand) raised next to the face
properties.posePresetKpopBoxArmsHint: Right-angle robot arms — upper arm horizontal, forearm vertical
properties.posePresetKpopPointDanceHint: Hip popped to the side, pointing up with the other hand on the hip
properties.posePresetKpopShoulderWaveHint: Isolation: right shoulder raised, torso following
properties.posePresetJumpingHint: Airborne, legs tucked and arms up — the only pose with no ground contact
properties.posePresetThrowingHint: Right arm cocked back and torso rotated, an instant before the release
properties.posePresetKickingBallHint: Right foot at the height of a ball on the ground, standing leg straight
properties.posePresetCarryingBoxHint: Forearms horizontal with palms up, torso leaning back as a counterweight
properties.posePresetClimbingHint: Right arm stretched high, right knee up and left foot on the ground
properties.posePresetStepUpHint: Right foot on a 0.22 m step, left foot pushing off on the toes
properties.posePresetBalletPreparationHint: Demi-plié with turned-out feet and arms in second position: the wind-up the pirouette springs from.
properties.posePresetBalletPirouetteHint: Retiré pirouette: balanced on the straight left leg, on half-point, with the right leg raised — knee turned out and the foot at the supporting knee. Arms rounded in front.
properties.posePresetHandshakeHint: Apply to BOTH figures, facing each other, 0.76 m apart
properties.posePresetHugHint: Apply to BOTH figures, facing each other, 0.26 m apart — any closer and the heads intersect
properties.posePresetDanceLeadHint: Closed ballroom hold — pairs with "Dancing (follow)" at 0.36 m
properties.posePresetDanceFollowHint: One hand clasped, the other on their shoulder — pairs with "Dancing (lead)" at 0.36 m
properties.posePresetCarryingPiggybackHint: Pairs with "Piggyback (carried)" 0.16 m behind, both facing the same way
properties.posePresetCarriedPiggybackHint: Riding on the other figure's back — pairs with "Piggyback (carrying)"
properties.posePresetCarryingCradleHint: Forearms forming a stretcher, palms up — pairs with "Cradle (carried)"
properties.posePresetCarriedCradleHint: Lying across the other figure's arms — pairs with "Cradle (carrying)"
properties.posePresetPullingUpHint: Weight thrown back, hand reaching out — pairs with "Being helped up" at 0.69 m
properties.posePresetBeingPulledUpHint: Half-kneeling on the ground, arm stretched up — pairs with "Pulling someone up"
properties.posePresetPushGivingHint: Both arms extended, palms forward — pairs with "Push (taking)" at 0.47 m
properties.posePresetPushTakingHint: Torso arched back and one foot leaving the ground — pairs with "Push (giving)"
properties.posePresetKneeStrikeGivingHint: Clinch grip on the other's head with the right knee driving upward — pairs with "Knee strike (taking)" at 0.37 m
properties.posePresetKneeStrikeTakingHint: Body folded over and head pulled down by the knee strike to the belly — pairs with "Knee strike (giving)"
properties.posePresetArmLockPushGivingHint: Crouched behind, knee in the back and a lock on the right arm, pushing the other forward — pairs with "Arm lock — push (taking)" at 0.24 m
properties.posePresetArmLockPushTakingHint: Seated with the right leg trapped, curved forward by the push — pairs with "Arm lock — push (giving)"
properties.posePresetArmLockPullGivingHint: Same lock, wrenching the other's wrist hard backward — pairs with "Arm lock — pull (taking)" at 0.24 m
properties.posePresetArmLockPullTakingHint: Spine twisted and arched back at the limit of the joint — pairs with "Arm lock — pull (giving)"
properties.posePresetClinchHint: Apply to BOTH figures, facing each other, 0.40 m apart — hands behind the other's head
properties.posePresetMeditatingHint: Cross-legged, spine upright, hands resting on the knees with palms up
properties.posePresetBusinessmanHint: Arms crossed with posture: chest out, shoulders back and feet apart
properties.posePresetHeroStanceHint: Hands on hips, chest out and legs wide apart
properties.posePresetLyingSpreadSupineHint: Belly up, arms spread out to the sides and legs apart
properties.posePresetLyingSpreadProneHint: Face down, arms raised above the head and legs apart; the head turns to the side, otherwise the nose would go through the floor
properties.posePresetSittingLegsForwardHint: On the ground, legs forward and palms flat behind propping up the torso
properties.posePresetSittingKneesBentHint: On the ground, knees up and palms flat behind; the pelvis reclines 25° because the hip only flexes 120°
properties.posePresetRearChokeKneelingHint: Kneeling behind — pairs with "Rear choke (taking)" 0.45 m ahead, both facing the same way
properties.posePresetRearChokeSeatedHint: Seated on the ground, pulled backwards by the hold — pairs with "Rear choke (giving)"
properties.posePresetGroundChokeGivingHint: Lying on their back underneath, legs wrapped around the other's torso — pairs with "Ground rear choke (taking)"
properties.posePresetGroundChokeTakingHint: Lying on their back ON TOP of the other (the preset already lifts them) — move them 0.10 m towards their own feet
properties.randomPoseHint: Draws every body joint within its limits (hands stay open)
properties.symmetryHint: Applies to arms, hands, legs and feet — trunk and head stay put.
properties.symmetryScopeHint: Applies from {{joint}} down, on both sides — nothing else changes.
properties.mirrorWholeHint: Full mirror: limbs swap sides and the torso, neck and head — which have no pair — get their angle inverted. It always covers the whole figure, not the selected joint. Where it stands and which way it faces do not change.
properties.seatOnGroundHint: Raises or lowers the figure until the pose touches the ground, without changing the pose or where it stands
properties.liveMirrorOnHint: On: adjusting a joint on one side writes the mirrored motion on the joint of the other side (locked joints are left alone).
properties.liveMirrorOffHint: Off: each side is adjusted on its own. Turn it on to pose symmetry (squats, open arms) in half the work.
properties.resetGroupHint: Returns the whole group to the neutral (standing) pose. Locked joints are left alone.
properties.copyPoseGroupHint: Copies only that group's joints. The receiver's placement does not change — the figure stays where and how it was.
properties.poseMixHint: 0% = the current pose, 100% = the chosen one. The result is a single still pose — not an animation.
properties.savePoseHint: Stores this figure's pose (lying and sitting included) so you can reapply it to any figure in any scene.
properties.copyPoseHint: Carries the joints and the placement (body tilt and hip height). The other figure stays where it is and keeps its height, colour and name — and its locked joints are left alone.
properties.lockJointHint: A locked joint changes for nothing: sliders, gizmo, keyboard, IK, random, mirror and applying a pose.
properties.jointLockedHint: Joint locked — nothing changes it until you unlock it.
properties.ikLockedHint: A joint in this limb is locked: IK will not move it.
properties.resetJointHint: Returns the joint to its "Standing" pose value (the model's neutral), leaving the others untouched.

camera.title: Camera
camera.lensHint: {{term}} ({{family}}) — {{fov}}° vertical field of view. With a shot active, changing the lens keeps the framing and changes only the perspective.

lensFamily.portrait: flattens the face and blurs the background
lensFamily.superTele: glues the background to the subject

camera.viewNeedsSelection: Select a figure for this view.
camera.viewNeedsPair: This view needs two figures with one of them selected.
camera.viewNeedsShot: Choose and apply a shot size first.
camera.shotExtremeWide: Figure tiny in a vast setting
camera.shotWide: Whole body, with the setting around it
camera.compositionLeadRoom: Space in front of the gaze
camera.viewTwoShot: The figure and its nearest neighbour
camera.shotsHint: The English term is what goes into a prompt; the caption explains it. The shot decides the crop, the angle decides the height you look from.
camera.angleOverTheShoulder: Behind one figure, onto the other
camera.rollHint: With the camera tilted, mouse orbiting turns around the tilted axis — straighten to go back to normal.
camera.moveDollyZoom: Vertigo effect: background moves, subject does not
camera.moveHint: Each end stores position, target, tilt and lens. For a dolly zoom, set A close with a wide lens and B far with a telephoto.
camera.moveNeedsBothPoints: Set A and B (or set A and use one of the shortcuts) to enable the slider.
camera.moveToKeyframesHint: Appends two keyframes to the end of the animation — the scene as it is now, with the camera at A and then at B.
camera.moveToKeyframesNeedsFigure: A keyframe is a portrait of the scene: add at least one figure.
camera.shotsGroup: With no figure selected, the wide shots frame every figure together, aiming at the midpoint of the group. Close-Up and Extreme Close-Up need a selected figure.

snapshots.title: Snapshots
snapshots.directoryNotChosen: No folder chosen — captures will be downloaded.
snapshots.directoryUnavailable: This browser doesn't support choosing a folder — captures will be downloaded.

animation.title: Animation
animation.name: Name
animation.saveToLibraryHint: Stores a copy of the working animation under this name, to reopen whenever you want.
animation.openHint: Opening replaces the working animation — Ctrl+Z brings back what was in it.
animation.overwriteSavedHint: Replaces the chosen saved animation with the current working one, keeping its name.
animation.updateConfirmHint: Re-recording replaces this keyframe's stored pose and camera with what is on screen.
animation.copyCameraPrevHint: Copy the previous keyframe's camera — this keyframe's pose is untouched
animation.copyCameraNextHint: Copy the next keyframe's camera — this keyframe's pose is untouched
animation.copyPosePrevHint: Copy the previous keyframe's pose — this keyframe's camera is untouched
animation.copyPoseNextHint: Copy the next keyframe's pose — this keyframe's camera is untouched
animation.duplicateKeyframeHint: Creates a copy right after this keyframe — two identical portraits in a row are a hold.
animation.timelineMoved: Timeline ({{time}} of {{total}}): the ruler, transport and keyframe stepping live in the bottom bar.
animation.insertHint: Creates a keyframe at the timeline's instant, holding the scene already shown there. The segment is split in two and the animation stays exactly the same — the new keyframe is just a point to adjust.
animation.closeCycleHint: Copies the first keyframe to the end so the last transition returns to the starting point — that is what makes a walk cycle loop seamlessly.
animation.repeatHint: On screen only: the exported video still contains a single pass.
animation.playheadHere: The timeline stopped at this keyframe
animation.onionSkinHint: Shows the neighbouring keyframes as ghosts around the one at the playhead — the previous one warm, the next one cool. On screen only: it stays out of the image and the video.
animation.speedHint: Applies to the whole timeline, both when playing and in the video: 0.50 plays at half speed, 1.15 speeds it up by 15%. Keyframes stay where they are. Final video: {{duration}}.
animation.thumbnailsHint: Renders a small portrait of each keyframe so you can tell them apart. Kept in memory only — it does not bloat the file or enter undo.
animation.clipSavedHint: Clip you saved: {{count}} role(s) to fill. The current camera is frozen into every keyframe.
animation.clipSavedNeedsDistinct: Each role needs a different figure.
animation.clipRangeTooShort: The range needs at least two keyframes.
animation.clipSaveHint: Stores this range of keyframes as a reusable clip — poses, placement and durations, without the camera.
animation.clipAddHint: Appends the clip's keyframes to the end of the timeline, starting from where figure A stands and faces, with the current camera frozen in all of them.
animation.clipNeedsTwoFigures: Pair scenes need two different figures in the scene.
animation.clipHintWalking: A takes four steps forward, in the direction it faces.
animation.clipHintRunning: A runs four strides forward, with an airborne phase.
animation.clipHintJumping: A crouches, jumps in place and lands.
animation.clipHintKpopFingerHeart: Raises the finger heart next to the face and gives the pose a little pulse.
animation.clipHintKpopBoxArms: Right-angle robot arms, alternating which side tucks in.
animation.clipHintKpopPointDance: Hip popped and arm pointing, alternating sides.
animation.clipHintKpopShoulderWave: Shoulder isolation alternating sides, like a wave.
animation.clipHintBalletPirouette: Prepares in plié, rises on half-point and turns twice on the left leg with the right in retiré, landing back in plié.
animation.clipHintDance: A leads and B follows, turning a full circle in closed position.
animation.clipHintHandshake: A and B approach, shake hands twice and let go.
animation.clipHintShoulderSpin: A pushes B by the shoulder; B spins and ends with the back to A — the entry for moves from behind.
animation.clipHintPiggyback: B climbs onto A's back, and A carries them three steps.
animation.clipHintCarryCradle: A kneels, picks B up in a cradle carry and carries them two steps.
animation.clipHintClinch: A and B close in, lock in a clinch and fight for the turn.
animation.clipHintPunch: A winds up and lands a cross; B takes it and staggers back.
animation.clipHintKick: A chambers the knee and lands a front kick; B takes it and staggers.
animation.clipHintKneeStrike: Both start at rest, close into a clinch, and A drives a knee into B's belly — B tumbles through the air and lands seated, back turned to A.
animation.clipHintArmLock: Both start at rest; A crouches behind seated B, traps the leg and arm, pushes forward with body weight, then wrenches the wrist hard backward.
animation.clipHintRearChokeStanding: Both start standing, B facing away: A locks the choke and B sinks to the knees.
animation.clipHintRearChokeSeated: Both start standing, B facing away: B sits, A kneels behind and applies the choke.
animation.clipHintRearChokeGround: Both start standing, B facing away: the choke locks seated and A rolls back taking B on top.
animation.startByCapturing: Capture the first keyframe — the working animation is created for you.
animation.needsFigures: Add at least one figure to the scene before capturing.
animation.needsPerspective: The animation uses the perspective camera — leave the orthographic view to capture.
animation.errorNoCodec: This browser can't encode video — export isn't available here.
animation.errorExport: Export failed. Try again with a smaller resolution.

scenes.title: Scenes
scenes.workspaceFolderUnavailable: This browser doesn't support choosing a folder — use the individual files (workspace.json + joint-limits.json + poses.json + .glb) to open a saved workspace.
scenes.customJointLimits_one: This workspace customizes the joint limits of {{count}} joint (joint-limits.json).
scenes.customJointLimits_other: This workspace customizes the joint limits of {{count}} joints (joint-limits.json).
scenes.newWorkspaceConfirm: This deletes every figure, saved scene, camera bookmark, saved pose and custom joint limit, and clears the undo history. Ctrl+Z cannot bring it back.

help.title: Keyboard shortcuts
help.arrows: Rotate the selected joint on the active axis (or move the root on the ground)
help.cycleJoint: Cycle through the current figure's joints
help.selectFigure: Select a figure by its position
help.toggleIK: Toggle FK/IK on the selected joint's limb
help.applyCameraBookmark: Go to a saved camera bookmark
help.frameFigure: Frame the camera on the selected figure
help.saveScene: Save the current scene to the catalog

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.visitedKeyframe: Keyframe {{index}} is on the working scene

errors.importUnreadable: The file could not be read — the .glb looks corrupted or is not valid glTF.
errors.importMissingAppData: The file is a valid .glb but has no Virtual Mockup data (custom properties). Re-export it with custom properties enabled.
errors.importFailed: The file could not be imported.
errors.workspaceManifestMissing: The selection did not include workspace.json — pick it together with the scene .glb files.
